playbackPlan.scope: First audition six existing lessons; expand only after listening to an actual recording.
playbackPlan.firstUse: Offer Hear the court cue at completion only when a real recording exists. Speech requires its own explicit opt-in; current sound permission does not silently enable narration.
playbackPlan.presentation: Use the existing court cue as the exact spoken transcript. Add no extra recap paragraph. Keep the sourced Pro Lens available separately.
playbackPlan.repetition: One court cue at completion; no voice on each right answer or automatic repeat from replaying a point. Occasionally include one eligible short sign-off; most endings use the cue alone, and no sign-off repeats on consecutive completions.
playbackPlan.rewardMixRecommendation: When spoken coaching is enabled, use the voice as the completion payoff instead of stacking it with applause. Retain the existing applause behavior when speech is off. This is a proposed listening choice, not a shipped change.
playbackPlan.control: A visible replay/stop action, persistent separate speech preference, and immediate stop on global mute, background or navigation. Never block Save cue or Next challenge.
playbackPlan.loading: Serve mastered audio from the app origin, load only after opt-in, and never play a missed completion late when a download finishes.
playbackPlan.scoreTruth: All six scripts are score-neutral. Any future Three good decisions line must require three accepted first answers. No claim of measured on-court improvement.
playbackPlan.mastering: Dry close voice, no room echo, no music or added outdoor ambience beneath speech. Preserve a natural finish, balance by perceived loudness, and check intelligibility on phone speakers before rollout.

recordingBlocker.requiredNextAction: Speech access must become available in the connected Runway workspace before the James/Paula audition can run. No subscription purchase or live-app change made.

occasionalSignOffs.delivery: Same consistent conversational voice as the court cue. At most one phrase, no hype or imitation of a player. Audition natural delivery before choosing frequency or placement.
